behavior: setup-node's inputs, defaults and outputs (cache-hit included) read from action.yml, and every third-party action is pinned by a 40-hex SHA with its tag.
verification: bats tests/setup-node.bats --filter 'inputs and their defaults|outputs map|pinned by full SHA'

behavior: The Node version comes from the version input or the version file, and with neither the step fails naming both.
verification: bats tests/setup-node.bats --filter 'version input|version file|neither a version'

behavior: The smoke job runs setup-node from this checkout against its fixture, behind gate; its second run reports cache-hit true.
verification: grep -qE '^- \[x\] AC3 .*cache-hit=true' specs/CI-004-toolchain-setup/verification.md && bats tests/setup-node.bats --filter 'gate needs|smoke|toolchains area|fixture'

behavior: setup-node runs on the Gitea runner in imagesensortool, and the cache hits there or degrades with the job green.
Every cache key names runner.os and runner.arch.
